blocks.tamil_translation: And establish Salah; and give Zakat, and bow in ruku' along with those who bow in ruku'.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: اَلْمُؤَذِّنُ يُغْفَرُ لَهُ مَدَي صَوْتِهِ، وَيَشْهَدُ لَهُ كُلُّ رَطْبٍ وَيَابِسٍ، وَشَاهِدُ الصَّلَاةِ يُكْتَبُ لَهُ خَمْسٌ وَعِشْرُونَ صَلَاةً، وَيُكَفَّرُ عَنْهُ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب رفع الصوت بالاذان رقم:٥١٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “The Mu'adhdhin's sins are forgiven to the extent that his voice reaches”, (even if the places as far as his voice is heard were filled with sins, all of them would be forgiven). All things living and lifeless that hear the sound of his Adhan will bear witness for him on the Day of Qiyamah. For those who hear the sound of the Mu'adhdhin's Adhan and come to pray, the reward of 25 Salahs is written. The sins that occurred in the interval from one Salah to the next are forgiven.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Some of the scholars have explained that “the rewards of 25 Salahs are written for the Mu'adhdhin, and the Mu'adhdhin's sins that occurred in the interval from one Adhan to the next are forgiven.”
(Badhl-ul-Majhud)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: يُغْفَرُ لِلْمُؤَذِّنِ مُنْتَهَي أَذَانِهِ، وَيَسْتَغْفِرُ لَهُ كُلُّ رَطْبٍ وَيَابِسٍ سَمِعَ صَوْتَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد والطبراني في الكبير والبزار الا انه قال: وَيُجِيبُهُ كُلُّ رَطْبٍ وَيَابِسٍ. ورجاله رجال الصحيح مجمع الزوائد:٢ /٨١
